name: Trinity College Dublin
description: Trinity College, a research university in Dublin, was founded in 1592 by Queen Elizabeth I based on the universities of Oxford and Cambridge. Considered one of Europe's outstanding universities, Trinity College is also called Ireland's most prestigious university. Trinity College's library is the largest in Ireland. Although the school is best known for its achievements in law, literature, and the humanities, it also conducts large-scale research in the fields of nanotechnology, engineering, politics, psychology, and English. Trinity currently has more than 18,000 students, 24% of whom are foreign nationals. In addition, with its 47-acre campus in the heart of Dublin, the school is close to many museums, theatres, restaurants, and historical sites. The success of undergraduate and graduate programs in Ireland has been proven worldwide. Trinity College, which was the first Irish school to be among the top 50 universities in 2009, is now the 101st university in the world according to the QS World University Ranking.
